column1: # Everything the converters read from the Director's Cut sh2pc.exe (MD5 f3f5360298b6d0f6f2e09cf24a0925d1).
# tools/sh2conv/pcexe.py compares another exe with it; `pcexe.py trace` rewrites it whenever a
# converter reads the exe differently. It holds addresses, sizes and digests only: each digest
# (the first 16 hex digits of an MD5) covers at least 32 bytes, too many to find from it.
#   range  address  size  group        a run of bytes read by address, compared as part of its group
#   group  id       size  md5  converters   the digest of its ranges' bytes, in address order
#   calls  target   -     md5  converters   the addresses of every call to target in the code
#   find   pattern  -     md5  converters   the addresses of every occurrence of pattern
